scope: All curricular source selection in MING_KNOWLEDGE; implementation in existing runtime/global exports requires their own integration and validation.
conflict_rule: For the same point, meaning and context, prefer the attested textbook/workbook evidence over presentations or worksheets.
between_books_rule: Preserve each book task and context. A genuine unresolved disagreement between the two primary books is flagged; do not invent a universal winner.
missing_primary_evidence: Keep absence or conflict explicit. Supplement-only material remains identified as supplementary; do not fabricate source evidence or silently use model knowledge.
source_fields: Preserve original documentary fields; store selection and any separately authorized editorial annotation independently.
answer_keys: Handwriting and similar dialogues are not official answer keys; missing original audio is not supplied by this policy.
